title: User profile, site and password
html:
Clicking your user name lets you customise your personal profile: change your own data and password, enable two-factor authentication, upload a profile picture and switch site.

To change the password, enter the old password, then the new one twice, and click Save. If you have forgotten your password, a user with admin level can reset it to the default. By default the password must be at least 8 characters long.
